description: Born for the apex and high-speed straightaways, the Bell Star DLX MIPS Gloss Black is born on the race grid to conquer high-speed turbulence. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1291g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~91 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and a glove-friendly quick-release ratcheting buckle.

introduction: Positioned in Bell's Full Face lineup, the bell_star_dlx_mips_gloss-black brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Bell Star DLX MIPS Gloss Black represents Bell's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~91 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Bell Star DLX MIPS Gloss Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
